scope: One prospective effective-model extension and one bounded ordinary-only fit. No hardware actions or S3R2 validation access.
structure: M=[[1,eta],[eta,1]], M*v_dot=diag(g)*queuedCommand-B*v-K*p-Coulomb(v); previous eight coefficients unchanged in definition
hypothesisNotPhysicalCalibration: Independent common/difference modal inertia may matter. Actual eta and rigid-body/encoder-carriage equivalence are not established.
training: Same Q2S68012 ordinary BLNN only. 8000 exact moving intervals and 300 hold endpoints. Hold commands are constant-mean ZOH abstraction, not recovered 1ms waveforms.
objective: Same round65 elapsed-time-weighted mean-position and full left-minus-right sync prediction errors in mm plus 1e-8 scaled-parameter norm. 8300 endpoints are not independent trials.
initialState: p=v=0 once for whole20s; no future measured states injected
initialParameters: Round65 frozen eight coefficients plus eta=0; no seed grid
solverChecksBeforeFit: Native/Python single-step KKT and energy, eta=0 regression, sticking, free decay, rejected invalid mass
afterFreeze: Independent Python20k-step check; native40ms metrics; same-mean100count hold-ordering stress; eta=0 with other fitted parameters fixed (conditional sensitivity only, not independently retrained ablation)
stop: Retain all evaluations and negative results after this one budget. No post-result parameter/bounds/objective edits or additional branch in this round.
interpretation: Training fit is not independent predictive validation, closed-loop improvement or model closure. Sensor model and hold input remain unverified.
